module origen_050954 #(
    parameter N = 4
) (
    input [N-1:0] a, b,
    input ci,
    output [N-1:0] s,
    output co
);

    wire [N-1:0] p, g;
    wire [N:0] c;

    // Generate and propagate signals
    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < N; i = i + 1) begin : gen_pg
            and(g[i], a[i], b[i]);
            xor(p[i], a[i], b[i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    // Carry input
    buf(c[0], ci);

    // Carry look-ahead logic
    generate
        if (N == 1) begin : gen_1bit
            or(c[1], g[0], (p[0] & c[0]));
        end
        else begin : gen_nbit
            wire [N-1:0] pc [N-1:0];
            genvar j, k;
            for (j = 0; j < N; j = j + 1) begin : gen_carry
                for (k = 0; k <= j; k = k + 1) begin : gen_term
                    if (k == 0)
                        and(pc[j][k], p[j], c[0]);
                    else if (k == j)
                        or(c[j+1], g[j], pc[j][j-1]);
                    else
                        and(pc[j][k], p[j], pc[j-1][k-1]);
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    // Sum calculation
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < N; i = i + 1) begin : gen_sum
            xor(s[i], p[i], c[i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    // Carry output
    buf(co, c[N]);

endmodule
